title: Future Trends for Human-AI Collaboration: A Comprehensive Taxonomy of AI/AGI Using Multiple Intelligences and Learning Styles
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Moral and Ethical Intelligence (MQ)' as one of the seven core intelligences in its proposed taxonomy for AGI. It provides a definition and a framework for 'Responsible (ethical) decision making', which includes evaluating actions based on principles like justice, fairness, and social responsibility.
